name: Caesar
source:
Caesar is a lycamorph dressmaker who has ventured into the fairy town of Fitzburg with the goal of creating clothes for fairies. He finds himself facing additional challenges due to his canine colourblindness and discrimination against lycamorphs from the side of the Tailors' Guild. This is when he teams up with Moth, the protagonist, for a daring collaboration.

Caesar is shy in nature and very dedicated to his craft. He is a potential love interest, though romance is optional,  it's not required for getting a good ending.
